en.title: Accessibility Setbacks and Advances Highlighted in Global News
en.summary: On September 5, a Canadian senior who had relied on an accessible bus for 28 years was abruptly denied service after officials claimed his wheelchair exceeded the vehicle’s safety load limit. Meanwhile, the Gesa Power House Theatre completed renovations to improve wheelchair access and other disability accommodations for all patrons. Additionally, Taiwan’s Executive Yuan Ocean Affairs Council hosted an accessible seaside experience, allowing people with disabilities to enjoy marine activities.

highlights.title: Canadian Disabled Senior Denied Accessible Bus After 28 Years, Cited Wheelchair Exceeds Safety Load
Gesa Power House Theatre renovates to ensure accessibility to all
People with disabilities bravely challenge! Executive Yuan's Ocean Affairs Council holds accessible seaside experience activity

zh-TW.title: 無障礙新聞聚焦：巴士拒載與場館改造
zh-TW.summary: 2026年9月5日，加拿大一名使用無障礙巴士28年的殘障長者因輪椅超過安全載重而被拒載，引發關注。同期，Gesa Power House劇場完成翻修，提升輪椅通道與其他無障礙設施，確保所有觀眾皆能便利觀賞。行政院海洋委員會亦舉辦無障礙親海體驗活動，讓身障者參與海洋活動。

highlights.title: 加拿大殘疾長者乘無障礙巴士28年突遭拒載！竟稱輪椅超出安全承載
Gesa Power House Theatre 進行翻修以確保所有人的無障礙
身心障礙者勇於挑戰！行政院海洋委員會舉辦無障礙親海體驗活動
